control.name: gridControl
control.windowcaption: Scroll Annotations: UI and Data customization
control.description: The CustomScrollAnnotation event allows you to specify custom annotations to be displayed in the scrollbar. This code uses custom annotations to create bookmarks.

control.name: optionsPage
control.windowcaption: Scroll Annotations: Colors and Visibility customization
control.description: The OptionsScrollAnnotations property allows you to choose annotation types displayed in the scrollbar. The ScrollAnnotationsStyle event is handled to customize annotation colors and alignment.
